Q: 在管理器内删除资源后，本地的资源会删除吗？: Q: If I delete a resource in the manager, is the local file deleted too?
A: 永远不会！管理器只会删除资源在管理器内的引用，不会删除本地的资源。: A: Never. The manager only removes its own reference and does not delete the local file.

GreenResourcesManager（绿色资源管理器） 是一个专为仓鼠症用: GreenResourcesManager (Green Resource Manager) is a portable media manager for people who hoard files. It is built for large, mixed libraries of games, images, videos, novels, websites, and audio, so you are not stuck with Windows folders and can manage them more freely.
Green Resources Manager 是一款专为\"仓鼠症\"用户设计: Green Resources Manager is an all-in-one media manager for "digital hoarders". Cheaper storage made huge personal libraries possible, and also harder to manage. Once a library passes 10TB, sorting by type or by how often you use something is not enough.
Green Resources Manager 应运而生: That is why Green Resources Manager exists

进入设置的「页面管理」，点「添加新页面」。先选游戏、番剧、小说、电影、漫画、单图: Open Settings, then Page management, and click Add page. Pick games, anime, novels, movies, comics, single images, software, websites, audio, or other, then name the page. The template decides which files, buttons, and filters it starts with.
程序会把 configs/pages 里对应的模板复制成一份新的 json，文件: The app copies the matching template in configs/pages into a new json file whose name starts with custom-, and registers it in pageOrder.json. The new page has its own id, so its list stays separate.
点这一页的铅笔，可以改名称、图标、接受的文件、编辑时显示的字段、侧边栏筛选、每页: Click the pencil to change the name, icon, accepted files, visible fields, sidebar filters, page size, card width, empty-state text, add and edit dialog titles, and sort options.
页面管理里可以打开配置目录，直接编辑这些 json。改的是这一页怎么显示和接受什: Page management can open the config folder so you can edit the json directly. That changes how the page looks and what it accepts. Saved resource data stays as it is.
文件按本身分类：: Files are classified by what they are:
接受的资源按文件本身分，例如可执行文件、压缩包、图片、图片文件夹、视频、视频文件: Accepted resources are split by the file itself, such as executables, archives, images, image folders, videos, video folders, novel files, audio, and links. A file is assigned to the earliest matching kind in the list.
🎯 用插件自定义功能: 🎯 Add a feature with a plugin
放在应用根目录的 mods 文件夹。创意工坊页面可以打开这个文件夹。每个插件是一: Put them in the mods folder at the app root. The Workshop page can open that folder. Each plugin is a subfolder with at least manifest.json and an entry script, index.js by default.
放好后，在创意工坊点「刷新」。新插件默认是关的，打开开关才会加载。关掉开关会卸载: After adding the folder, click Refresh in the Workshop. New plugins start off. Turning the switch on loads the plugin. Turning it off unloads it and removes its sidebar entry.
index.js 使用 export default。加载时调用 onLoad(: index.js uses export default. onLoad(api) runs when it loads, and onUnload(api) runs when it unloads. Do not use import. The loader does not resolve outside modules.
api.storage.get、set、remove。数据写在本机，键名会自动加: api.storage.get, set, and remove. Data stays on this computer. The key is prefixed with the plugin id so plugins do not collide.
api.navigation.register，传入 id、name、icon: api.navigation.register takes id, name, icon, and onClick. Call api.navigation.unregister when you no longer need it.
api.ui.showNotification(标题, 类型, { messag: api.ui.showNotification(title, type, { message }). The type can be success, info, or error.
api.ui.showCustomView({ title, content,: api.ui.showCustomView({ title, content, onMount }). content is HTML. onMount receives the page container so you can bind button clicks.
把下面两份文件放进 mods/hello-note，刷新创意工坊并打开开关。侧边: Put these two files in mods/hello-note, refresh the Workshop, and turn the plugin on. A Notes entry appears in the sidebar and opens the plugin’s own page.
mods/calendar-manager 是日期管理插件。它会在侧边栏加「日期: mods/calendar-manager is a calendar plugin. It adds Calendar to the sidebar, opens a month view, and stores events on this computer. Start from it when you need buttons and local data.
每种常见做法单独一页: Each common task has its own page
自定义有两条路。想多收一类文件，看「自定义页面」。想在侧边栏加一个程序里原来没有: There are two ways to customize. To collect another kind of file, open Custom pages. To add a feature the app does not have, open Custom features. The next two pages are examples you can copy.
从游戏、电影、小说这些模板复制一页资源名单，并改它接受什么文件、显示哪些字段和筛: Copy a page from a games, movies, or novels template, then change which files, fields, and filters it uses.
在 mods 文件夹里放一个插件。打开开关后，它可以在侧边栏登记入口，并打开自己: Put a plugin in the mods folder. After you turn it on, it can add a sidebar entry and open its own page.
最少的例子。两份文件放进 mods/hello-note，侧边栏就会多出一个「便: The smallest example. Two files in mods/hello-note add a Notes entry to the sidebar.
mods/calendar-manager 里的完整例子。它有月历、增删日程，并: The full example in mods/calendar-manager. It has a month view, adds and removes events, and stores them on this computer.
从模板复制一页，再改它怎么收文件: Copy a page from a template, then change which files it accepts
资源页面不是插件。它是侧边栏里的一张名单，用来收集某一类文件。: A resource page is a sidebar list for one kind of file.
文件按本身分类: Files are classified by what they are
用 mods 里的插件给侧边栏加一个新入口: Add a sidebar entry with a plugin in mods
插件适合程序里原来没有的功能。它不会变成一张收文件的资源页，而是自己登记一个侧边: Plugins are for features the app does not already have. A plugin adds its own sidebar entry and opens its own page.
两份文件就能在侧边栏加一个页面: Two files add a page to the sidebar
带月历和本地记录的完整例子: A full example with a month view and local storage
onLoad 里用 api.storage.get 读出已经记下的日程。: onLoad reads saved events with api.storage.get.
用 api.navigation.register 在侧边栏加上「日期管理」。: api.navigation.register adds Calendar to the sidebar.
点进去后，用 api.ui.showCustomView 打开月历。onMoun: The click opens the month view with api.ui.showCustomView. onMount binds previous month, next month, and add.
增删改之后调用 api.storage.set 写回本机。onUnload 时再: After a change, api.storage.set writes it back. onUnload saves once more and removes the sidebar entry.
：插件名称、版本和入口文件。: : the plugin name, version, and entry file.
：月历、日程的增删改，以及怎么调用接口。: : the month view, event changes, and the API calls.
往页面里加一条资源，或从名单里去掉: Add an item to a page, or take it off the list
游戏、图片、视频、小说、网站和音频都用同一套方式添加和删除。按钮上的文字会随当前: Games, images, videos, novels, websites, and audio are added and removed the same way. Button labels follow the current page.
点页面里的按钮：: Use the button on the page:
打开对应页面，点击页面内的添加按钮。按钮文字随页面变化，游戏页是「添加游戏」，电: Open the page and click its add button. The label follows the page: a game page says Add game, a movie page says Add movie.
在资源卡片上右键，选择删除这一条资源。游戏页里这项叫「删除游戏」，其它页面会换成: Right-click a card and choose the item that removes this resource. On a game page it says Delete game. Other pages use their own name.
点进这条资源，在详情页里也可以删除。: Open the resource. The detail page can delete it too.
删除只会从这一页的名单里去掉，不会删除磁盘上的文件。: This only removes it from the page list. The file on disk stays.
右键 .cbr 或 .cbz 漫画时，「用指定程序打开」会用这里选的程序。还没选: Right-click a .cbr or .cbz comic and choose Open with a chosen app. If none is set yet, you will be asked to pick one.
选择用来打开漫画压缩包的程序: Choose the app that opens comic archives
只能用这种方式打开 cbr 或 cbz 漫画压缩包: This only opens .cbr or .cbz comic archives
当前环境无法打开漫画压缩包: This environment cannot open comic archives
系统没有打开这个压缩包: The system did not open this archive
请到设置 → 图片里选择用来打开漫画压缩包的程序: Choose the app under Settings → Images
当前环境不能用指定程序打开文件: This environment cannot open a file with a chosen app
指定程序没有打开这个压缩包: The chosen app did not open this archive
请改用「用默认程序打开」或「用指定程序打开」。指定程序可以在设置 → 图片里选好: Use Open with the default app, or Open with a chosen app. You can pick that app under Settings → Images.
当前旋转角度，翻页时保持不变: Current rotation. It stays when you turn the page.
已更新 {n} 个改名或移动的资源，还有 {m} 个文件不存在: Updated {n} renamed or moved item(s). {m} file(s) are still missing
有 {n} 个资源只是改了名字或移动了位置，已更新路径: {n} item(s) were only renamed or moved. Their paths are updated
还没有任何系统消息: There are no system messages yet
从左侧播放列表选择一首歌: Pick a song from the playlist on the left
音频文件路径不存在: Audio file path does not exist
输入页码后按回车跳转: Type a page number and press Enter
